title: Newton's Coefficient of Restitution Definition

variables.v_1, v_2: Final velocities along line of impact
variables.u_1, u_2: Initial velocities along line of impact

assumptions: Velocities measured strictly along the common normal (line of impact)
common_misuse: Applying e to velocity components parallel to contact surface
Writing (v1 - v2)/(u1 - u2) which yields negative e
source_provenance: HCV1 Ch 9 p. 167 eq. 9.24; UP Ch 8 p. 279
